verdict.rationale: Discord's developer platform supports building automated apps and bots (bot token, REST API) that react to Gateway events and webhooks, and those can run unattended in the background, for example CI/CD pipelines posting build results. However, this requires users to write and host their own bot or integration. The evidence shows no native, built-in automation builder or scheduler. Missing for 10: native no-code automation or scheduling, first-party hosting of background automations, AI/agent-specific automation features, independent hands-on corroboration.
